name: Vorlus Vilehoof
summary: In Darnassus, young night elf warriors face a trial set by Elanaria. They must hunt a satyr who has defiled a hidden moonwell near the Ban'ethil Barrow Den.

sections.title: A Test of Resolve
sections.body: Elanaria asks you to prove your dedication and discipline before she teaches advanced martial techniques. She needs more than words from those who defend Kalimdor. A guardian must face corruption and cleanse the sacred boughs of Teldrassil.

sections.title: Defiling the Sacred Waters
sections.body: Your trial leads to Vorlus Vilehoof, a satyr hiding at a moonwell in the mountains southeast of Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Satyrs were once ancient betrayers, twisted by demonic influence, and they hate sacred Kaldorei relics. Vorlus bathes in the moonwell, fouling its blessed waters and mocking the grace of Elune.

sections.title: Claiming the Horn
sections.body: Gnarlpine furbolgs guard a concealed mountain trail that leads to Vorlus. At the tainted spring, you face the satyr in combat. Bring his horn back to the Warrior's Terrace in Darnassus as proof of his death. The glade's sanctity can be restored, and the way opens to specialized martial weapons.

faq.answer: Vorlus Vilehoof is a corrupted satyr who dwells on Teldrassil. He found a secluded moonwell southeast of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den and began bathing in its consecrated waters, defiling them.

faq.q: Why does Elanaria send warriors after Vorlus?
faq.answer: Elanaria sends you after Vorlus as a proving trial for promising warriors. Defeating this dangerous, corrupt fiend shows the focus, courage, and resolve needed before she teaches advanced martial skills or guides you in forging specialized weapons.

faq.q: Where is the hidden moonwell located?
faq.answer: The hidden moonwell lies in the ridges southeast of Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Find the subtle mountain path lined with torches just behind a Gnarlpine furbolg encampment east of the barrows.

faq.q: What is a moonwell, and why does his presence matter?
faq.answer: Moonwells are sacred basins of blessed water that channel the light of Elune and sustain nature's vitality. A demonic satyr bathing in one desecrates Kaldorei faith and brings a dangerous source of corruption to Teldrassil.

faq.q: What comes after defeating Vorlus Vilehoof?
faq.answer: After you return Vorlus's severed horn, Elanaria is satisfied and confirms your readiness. She directs you onward to pursue the legendary Weapons of Elunite, beginning with uncovering the Shade of Elura.

faq.q: Are there other satyrs on Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Yes. Satyrs lurk on Teldrassil, including at Fel Rock and in scattered corrupt hollows, seeking to infect the World Tree with demonic taint.

angles.text: As a warrior, hunting Vorlus begins your initiation into advanced martial training. It shows that your blade protects Kaldorei lands and the sanctity of the goddess.
As a night elf, you know moonwells reflect the purity of Elune and the lifeblood of Kaldorei spirituality. A satyr bathing in their waters insults all night elves.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Teldrassil's interior from lurking demonic remnants, keeping Darnassus a steadfast redoubt for the Alliance in Northern Kalimdor.
